# async_poll_latest_ts — async_job with cursor_update.kind=latest_event_timestamp
# Walks submit → poll → fetch once, then asserts the cursor advances to the
# max event timestamp seen in the fetch step's body (2026-01-01T00:00:04Z
# given EventsPerDrain=5 with 1-second spacing) instead of using_now.
# phase: submit is restored after on_complete so the next iteration starts
# the chain over.

replace spec.yml /api/v1/exports /async_poll_latest_ts/exports
replace spec.yml http://localhost:9999 $URL
exec skopos run -i spec.yml --once --state state.json --trace trace.jsonl --out events.jsonl
normalize trace.jsonl
cmp trace.jsonl want_trace.jsonl
cmp events.jsonl want_events.jsonl
chomp want_state.json
cmp state.json want_state.json

-- spec.yml --
ir_version: "1"

state:
  fields:
    url:
      type: url
      default: "http://localhost:9999"
    api_key:
      type: secret
      default: "test-bearer-token-12345"

defaults:
  base_url: {ref: state.url}

auth:
  bearer:
    token: {ref: state.api_key}

requests:
  - id: submit
    method: POST
    path: /api/v1/exports
    body:
      json:
        since: {from_progress: latest_timestamp}
    expect_status: [202]

  - id: poll
    method: GET
    path:
      concat:
        - /api/v1/exports/
        - {ref: cursor.export_id}
        - /status

  - id: fetch
    method: GET
    url: {ref: cursor.result_url}

response:
  decode: json
  events_at: items

pagination:
  none: {}

progress:
  async_job:
    submit:
      step: submit
      extract:
        export_id: {path: export_id}
    poll:
      step: poll
      complete_when:
        eq:
          path: body.status
          equal: complete
      extract:
        result_url: {path: result_url}
    fetch:
      step: fetch
    on_complete:
      cursor_update:
        kind: latest_event_timestamp
        event_time:
          path: timestamp

error:
  mode: standard
-- want_trace.jsonl --

{"elapsed":"<scrubbed>","iteration":2,"method":"GET","phase":"poll","request_headers":{"Accept":"application/json, application/x-ndjson;q=0.9, */*;q=0.1","Authorization":"<redacted>"},"response_body":"body 100 bytes, object-like","started_at":"<scrubbed>","status":200,"step_id":"poll","url":"$URL_HOST/async_poll_latest_ts/exports/exp-000001/status"}
{"elapsed":"<scrubbed>","iteration":3,"method":"GET","phase":"fetch","request_headers":{"Accept":"application/json, application/x-ndjson;q=0.9, */*;q=0.1","Authorization":"<redacted>"},"response_body":"body 347 bytes, object-like","started_at":"<scrubbed>","status":200,"step_id":"fetch","url":"$URL_HOST/async_poll_latest_ts/results/exp-000001"}

-- want_state.json --
{
  "cursor": {
    "last_timestamp": "2026-01-01T00:00:04Z",
    "phase": "submit"
  }
}
